evidence.quote: Today, my remarks will highlight our work to enhance and improve the bank regulatory stress test framework.
Together, these rules reduce SCB volatility by half without materially changing aggregate levels of required capital.
As we count down to finalization of these rules, we are ready to begin a new era for stress testing: using this powerful tool to enhance supervision.
